paper_metadata.title: Development of the c0 phase strengthened high-temperature high-entropy alloys with excellent mechanical properties

evidence.quote: a series of novel c’ phase strengthened Ti6Al6-based HEAs with six kinds of alloying elements (including Nb, Hf, Ta, W, Mo, and V) were carefully examined
we choosed (FeCoNi)88Ti6Al6 as the base alloy
Refractory alloying elements such as W, Mo, V, and other elements are added to high-temperature HEAs
19 kinds of HEAs were prepared by vacuum arc melting under the protection of a high-purity Ar atmosphere
placed in a melting pool with a 5 mm × 10 mm × 50 mm suction casting mold for suction molding
all samples were homogenized at 1200 °C for 4 hrs and then by water quenching
followed by cold rolling with a rolling volume fraction of 66 %
The cold-rolled sheet was recrystallized at 1200 °C for about 10 mins to control the grain size
Finally, the samples were aged for 4 hrs at 800 °C to obtain the precipitates, and then water quenched
